'''Valerii Oleksandrovych Andriitsev''' ({{langx|uk|Валерій Олександрович Андрійцев}}; born 27 February 1987 in [[Kozelets]]) is a male freestyle wrestler from [[Ukraine]]. He won the silver medal in the [[Wrestling at the 2012 Summer Olympics - Men's freestyle 96 kg|Men's freestyle 96 kg]] at [[2012 Summer Olympics]]. He won the silver in the [[2012 European Wrestling Championships]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.foxnews.com/sports/2012/08/12/usa-varner-wins-wrestling-gold/|title=USA's Varner wins wrestling gold|publisher=Fox News|date= 12 August 2012 |access-date=7 September 2012}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.london2012.com/athlete/andriitsev-valerii-1051018/|publisher=www.london2012.com|title=Valerii Andriitsev Profile London Olympics 2012|date=7 September 2012|access-date=12 August 2012|archive-date=3 January 2013|archive-url=https://archive.today/20130103184336/http://www.london2012.com/athlete/andriitsev-valerii-1051018/|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/sports/london-olympics-2012/news/Lonon-Olympics-Varner-wins-96kg-freestyle-gold-for-US/articleshow/15461790.cms?prtpage=1|title=London Olympics: Varner wins 96kg freestyle gold for US|publisher=Times of India|date= 12 August 2012 |access-date=7 September 2012}}</ref> At the [[2014 World Wrestling Championships]] he took the bronze medal after winning a rematch against American [[Jake Varner]], who beat him in the gold medal match at the 2012 Olympics.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.olympic.org/london-2012/wrestling/freestyle-96-kg-men|title=London 2012 Freestyle 96 kg men - Olympic Wrestling|date=2016-06-27|access-date=2016-07-30}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://intermatwrestle.com/articles/13440|title=Men's freestyle World medalists|access-date=2016-07-30|archive-date=2020-10-25|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201025101626/https://intermatwrestle.com/articles/13440|url-status=dead}}</ref>  In June 2015, he earned bronze at the [[European Games 2015|inaugural European Games]] for [[Ukraine at the 2015 European Games|Ukraine]] in [[Wrestling at the 2015 European Games|wrestling]], more specifically, in the men's freestyle in the - 97&nbsp;kg division.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.baku2015.com/en_externalmodules/WR/pdf/WRM297000_C75_155.pdf|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150617190949/http://www.baku2015.com/en_externalmodules/WR/pdf/WRM297000_C75_155.pdf|url-status=usurped|archive-date=June 17, 2015|title=2015 European Games - Men's Freestyle 97kg|date=17 June 2015|access-date=30 July 2016}}</ref>
